mapper.select: SELECT user_id, user_name, user_password, user_email, user_phone_number, delete_flg, create_user, create_date, update_user, update_date FROM tb_mst_user_login WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_mst_user_login ( user_name, user_password, user_email, user_phone_number, delete_flg, create_user, create_date, update_user, update_date ) VALUES ( #{userName}, #{userPassword}, #{userEmail}, #{userPhoneNumber}, #{deleteFlg}, #{createUser}, #{createDate}, #{updateUser}, #{updateDate} )
